items.text: Kazem Gharibabadi responded to the US Treasury Secretary's claims, stating that the destruction of Iran's military capabilities and nuclear program is false. He added that the US has launched the largest financial assault in history against Iran. He questioned whether this is a victory or an admission of US failure.

Esteghlal club plans to file a complaint against Arif Hajiyedi after their victory over Sepahan in the third week of the Premier League. Hajiyedi made an unsportsmanlike gesture towards Esteghlal fans after the match. The game ended 2-0 in favor of Esteghlal.
Videos received show that Iranian residents in Britain gathered in London on Sunday, 1 Shahrivar. The gathering was against the Islamic Republic. The location of the gathering was London.

Iman Rashidi, a Bahá'í citizen residing in Yazd, was transferred to the prison in this city to serve his sentence. He was sentenced by the Revolutionary Court to three years, six months, and one day in prison. His transfer took place on Sunday, 1 Shahrivar.

Esmaeil Baqaei, the spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, called the deployment of US fuel carriers in Bulgaria a mistake and stated that the Islamic Republic has the right to target the origins of attacks against itself. He also said that the Islamic Republic has not received an invitation to join the Mecca defense agreement. Reports about the Strait of Hormuz being open were described as media warfare.

A group of Iranians living in Calgary participated in a protest march called "Run for Freedom." They carried images of the deceased and lion and sun flags. The participants demanded freedom for Iran under the leadership of Prince Reza Pahlavi.

The Najafabad representative announced that according to the approved plan, imprisonment for dowries exceeding 14 coins will be removed. For dowries less than 14 coins, enforcement through electronic ankle bracelets will be possible. This resolution has been sent to the Guardian Council for final review.

A citizen sent a video to Iran International showing that despite power outages and dark streets, the gathering place of government supporters is illuminated. The citizen described this situation as an example of the justice of the Islamic Republic.

Esmaeil Baghai stated that the Omani foreign minister's visit to Tehran is unrelated to the Pakistani army commander's visit and concerns bilateral relations and security in the Strait of Hormuz. He emphasized they will not allow the war to end on the aggressor's terms and have used all means to prevent it. He also called the naval blockade an act of aggression and said no country has the right to cooperate with the US in the economic war.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations announced that a tanker was hit by an unknown projectile near the port of Yanbu, Saudi Arabia, causing a fire. All crew members are safe. No report on environmental consequences has been released.

Amin Naseri, a citizen from Asmanabad, was arrested by the Intelligence Corps agents. During the arrest, he was involved in a confrontation and was shot and injured. He has been transferred to an unknown location.

A group of retired telecommunications workers gathered in Tehran on Tuesday, 24 August. They chanted slogans such as "Retiree, shout out, demand your rights." The gathering was reported through videos received by Iran International.

Abdolnaser Hemmati, the Central Bank governor, stated that new US sanctions do not create new pressure and there is no problem supplying currency. He is optimistic about the economic future and considers the increase in exchange rate gap temporary. Hemmati emphasized that short-term fluctuations should not change currency policies.

Ata Hosseinian reacted to the further reduction of the 3000-toman gasoline quota. He said this gradual reduction is preparing the ground for a plan that will force people to buy and sell gasoline at high prices. This plan could also increase economic pressure and inflation.

Esmail Baghai, spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, commented on the chess and poker games between Iran and the USA. He said Iran has been a chess player since long ago and recently has also become a poker player. He also mentioned that currently a combination of these two games is being played.

Ali Mousavi Nejad Farkoush, a civil activist, has been detained in Karaj Central Prison for over a month and remains in judicial uncertainty. This has been confirmed by a source close to his family. He has been in detention for 32 days.

Aref Haji-Aydi displayed inappropriate behavior towards Esteghlal fans after Sepahan's defeat in the third week of the Premier League. Esteghlal club plans to file a complaint against him to the Football Federation's disciplinary committee. Esteghlal won the match 2-0 against Sepahan.

China announced the meeting of the deputy foreign ministers of Iran and China with a six-day delay. This announcement coincides with the US warning to the trade partners of the Islamic Republic. More details are provided in an interview with the Iran International reporter.

Yesterday, dismissed workers of Shadgan Steel Industry Company held a protest in front of the company. They demanded attention to their job uncertainty and reinstatement. The protest was held to object to their working conditions.

The Supreme Court's 41st branch rejected the retrial request of Amir Rahimi, a teacher detained during the December 2025 protests. He was previously sentenced to four years in prison. This sentence was issued by the Lorestan Province Court of Appeals.

Donald Trump shared a Newsmax report about Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf's remarks in Iraq on the Truth Social network. Ghalibaf stated that Iran is facing economic problems and cannot endure. He described the economy and security as two interdependent wings.

The head of Tehran's Fire Department stated that most schools in the capital are old, unsafe, and lack fire suppression systems. This situation is due to the high age of the schools. The process of making schools safe in Tehran has been reported as unfavorable.

A video circulated on social media shows the inside of a warehouse near Dastgerd Prison in Isfahan. It is reported that about 400 detainees from January 2026 are being held there without trial and without their families' knowledge. This has raised concerns about the detainees' conditions.

Finance ministers of Germany, Austria, Spain, Italy, Portugal, and Poland have called for taxing the profits of oil companies due to price increases following the closure of the Strait of Hormuz. They stated in a letter to the EU presidency that government measures to reduce prices have been insufficient. The ministers emphasized the need for a joint approach to ensure companies benefiting from this crisis contribute to easing the burden on the public.

The historic ball from the 1986 World Cup quarterfinal match, with which Diego Maradona scored the famous 'Hand of God' goal, was sold at Heritage Auctions in the United States for $3.3 million. This price was much lower than the initial estimate of $10 million by experts.

Azita Asadi, director general of natural resources and watershed management in Qazvin, reported the injury of a natural resources protection unit member during firefighting operations in the villages of Keshabad and Sutekesh. The officer was injured last night while trying to control the fire and was transferred to a medical center.
A citizen posted a video stating that fuel stations in Mashhad do not provide gasoline even with fuel cards. This issue has been shared on social media. No official response has been announced yet.

Ghasem Ravanbakhsh, deputy head of the internal affairs commission in the parliament, stated that the presence of China and Russia alongside Iran will lead to the failure of the US sanctions strategy. He described the US action of maritime blockade against Iran as inhumane and called for a firm Iranian approach in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab. He also said the plan to control the Strait of Hormuz should be quickly brought to the parliament floor.

The company Ozon announced that four of its logistics centers in southern Russia were targeted by Ukrainian drone attacks. A video showing a fire at one of these centers near Makhachkala has been released. The number of targeted centers in the past 48 hours has reached six.

The Social Security Organization of Kish has not yet clarified the unemployment insurance status after 6 months. The Iran Telecommunication Manufacturing Company has not paid staff salaries for 9 months and provides no insurance. Additionally, in Ahvaz, hundreds of students could not register due to the lack of schools.
A group of women supporting the government gathered in Isfahan on Monday, September 2. They chanted the slogan "The hijab law must be enforced." This video was released by Iran International.

The International Atomic Energy Agency stated that even if the Strait of Hormuz reopens, the global energy situation will not return to the pre-war state. Restoring gas supply in the Middle East to pre-war levels will be difficult. The world has entered a new era in energy security.

Volodymyr Zelensky stated on Ukraine's Independence Day that Ukraine seeks peace but will not surrender to Russia. Meanwhile, European supporters of Ukraine are gathering in Kyiv to discuss strengthening air defense and increasing pressure on Moscow. This report was published by Iran International.

Twelve Baha'i citizens in Sari were sentenced by the Revolutionary Court to a total of 26 years and 165 days of imprisonment and 76 years of social rights deprivation. They were accused of conducting educational and promotional activities contrary to Islamic law. The hearings took place in August 2026.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, the Speaker of the Parliament, changed Donald Trump's campaign slogan to "Let's bring hunger back to America." He shared an image showing millions of Americans facing hunger. Ghalibaf also stated that failures cannot be covered up with false claims.

The mother of Nazanin Zahra Salehi is seen singing the song "Sougati" by Hayedeh at her daughter's grave. Nazanin Zahra, 13 years old, died on January 9, 2026, in Kermanshah due to gunfire from officers. This video was shared on social media.

Viewers of Iran International have reported a shortage of gasoline and closure of fuel stations in various cities. A citizen stated that fuel stations in Rudehen and Bumehen were closed last night. This report was published by Baharan Azadi from Iran International.

Mahtab Gholizadeh referred to Abdolnaser Hemmati's statements about the temporary nature of the currency rate surge and said that central bank heads have repeatedly made similar promises after each currency crisis. She added that Hemmati previously considered the dollar rate increase unrealistic and promised currency relief. These statements have not had a significant psychological impact on the market.

Ahmad Reza Radan, the commander of the national police, stated that the enemy seeks to create unrest using excuses such as livelihood and economic problems. He emphasized the important role of specialized police in identifying and confronting agitators. Radan also said the war is not over and the enemy remains active.

Oil prices fell by more than two percent on Monday, September 2, ahead of the announcement of a new US plan to increase economic pressure on Iran. Donald Trump described the plan as the most severe financial operation against Iran. The US Treasury Secretary is scheduled to provide more details about the plan.

Esmaeil Saghab Esfahani pointed to structural corruption in fuel smuggling in a video report. He stated that both political factions in the country are involved in fuel smuggling and that shutting down their operations would face resistance. This report was released on the occasion of Government Week.

A citizen sent a video to Iran International showing empty supermarket shelves in Tehran. He said dairy products and eggs are not available. People are quickly buying what they need, and it seems we are approaching a shortage.

Donald Trump, President of the United States, reposted a Newsmax article on Monday, Shahrivar 2, about remarks made last week by Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf in Iraq. Ghalibaf had said that America has been defeated in military war and has turned to economic and cognitive warfare. This repost came on the eve of unprecedented sanctions against Iran.

The head of the Tehran traffic police information department reported that out of 14,000 nighttime accidents causing damage, 4,000 resulted in injuries and over 130 deaths. Among the deceased, 58 were motorcyclists and 50 were pedestrians. These statistics pertain to the first five months of the year in the capital.

Gas stations in northern Tehran and on the Tehran-Karaj highway have been closed due to fuel shortages. The government has cut the May ration card for some people and announced verification requirements. Economic issues such as a sharp increase in phone prices and power outages in Ardabil have also been reported.

The US Treasury Secretary announced the start of an economic war against the Islamic Republic from dawn on Monday, calling it the final phase of US operations against Iran's government. Scott Bessent described the operation as the largest financial assault ever organized against one of America's enemies.

Donald Trump wrote on Truth Social that Iran is completely collapsing. He reposted a report about Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf's remarks on hunger in Iran. Also, Scott Bessent is set to announce new US sanctions against the Islamic Republic on Monday.

A citizen posted a video on social media showing a long queue of heavy vehicles waiting for diesel on the Haraz road. The video was shared on social media. The issue concerns fuel supply on this route.

A citizen stated in a video that people are forced to use worn-out tires in their cars due to high prices. This issue was shared on social media. The tire price increase has caused concern among the public.
Sepideh Abtahi, a filmmaker and editor, was released from Qarchak Varamin prison on Monday, 24 August 2026, under a bail order. This news was reported by HRANA news agency.

Houthi forces in Yemen announced they targeted a Saudi oil tanker in the northern Red Sea with a ballistic missile, causing a fire on the vessel. They also targeted gatherings of Saudi forces and military equipment in two other areas. The group emphasized continuing the maritime navigation ban against Saudi Arabia and stated they are ready to respond to any escalation.

The Food and Drug Administration announced that the Koldaniz nasal spray produced by Nafas Zist Pharmed is unauthorized due to microbial contamination and quality non-compliance. An immediate recall order has been issued for production batches 25AF007 and 24AF008. These batches will be collected nationwide.

Merchants and shopkeepers in Ahvaz protested today in front of Chamran University of Medical Sciences due to unpaid overdue claims since 2022. The protest took place on Monday, 24 August. They demand payment of their claims.

Rudiansah, a 16-year-old Indonesian teenager, is fighting forest fires in Central Kalimantan alongside his father and local volunteers. He wears a Superman costume while participating in firefighting groups. Rudiansah prefers joining firefighters after school instead of staying at home.
A citizen reported in a video to Iran International about the sharp increase in rice and oil prices in Iran. He said that with these price hikes, they are only trying to survive, not live.

Hossein Mohibi, spokesperson for the IRGC, stated that removing or threatening individuals does not disrupt the country's administration because the system is based on the bond between the people and the government. He said the enemy aimed to destabilize street security by targeting Basij bases, but the presence of police and Basij forces neutralized this plan. Mohibi also mentioned the continued production of smart missiles and transferring vulnerability to the enemy's critical infrastructure.

Yashar Tabrizi, a political prisoner in Tabriz prison, has been on a drug strike for 10 days due to inadequate medical care. This action was taken because he was not transferred to an outside hospital. The issue has been confirmed by sources close to his family.
The Crown Prince of Saudi Arabia was welcomed by Emmanuel Macron in Paris. The two-day trip aims to strengthen bilateral cooperation and discuss Middle East developments.

The US Treasury Secretary announced the start of the largest economic attack in history against the Islamic Republic. The goal of this policy is regime change. In Tehran, the dollar price exceeded 203,000 tomans, and the head of the Majlis medical office confirmed the reduction of gasoline quotas and price increases.

Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei responded to the economic threats and intensified sanctions by the US, stating that sanctions have existed before. He also emphasized that the US and Israel seek to create division among the people but will fail in this goal.

Mehdi Tartaar, the Persepolis coach, inspected the field and grass of Sahand Stadium in Tabriz before the match against Tractor. This occurred in an empty stadium without spectators. A video of this scene was published by Varzesh3.

A resident of Shahrak Razaviyeh in Tehran reported that they have no water or electricity. He also mentioned that with the 200,000 toman dollar rate, their refrigerators are empty. This issue was reported in a video to Iran International.

Antonio Guterres, the UN Secretary-General, emphasized the importance of unhindered shipping rights and freedoms. He identified attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea, as well as conflicts following Russia's invasion of Ukraine, as threats to vital shipping routes. This situation has led to rising prices and increased hunger, especially for the world's most vulnerable populations.

Sina Khalili and Abolfazl Mohammadnejad won two gold medals for Iran at the World Junior Freestyle Wrestling Championships. Iran finished in fourth place and did not reach the team podium for the first time in 10 years. An interview with Ebrahim Es-haqi was conducted about the competition.

Mohammad Mokhber stated that the enemy's strategies, including sanctions and war over the past 47 years, have failed. He said the enemy has faced the deterrence of the Islamic Republic in the Strait of Hormuz. He also warned that the Islamic Republic's response will be stronger.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated in a meeting with Asim Munir that the US has obstructed regional stability through bad faith. He emphasized that Iran is pursuing the implementation of the memorandum's conditions and that the US must adhere to its commitments. Ghalibaf also denied Tehran's influence by pressures.

Donald Trump stated on Truth Social that radical left Democrats are acting wildly with fake polls. He added that morale in the US is very high and the US is winning against everyone, including Iran. Trump also described Iran as a country in collapse.

A citizen sent a video to Iran International showing the empty refrigerator of his home. He said he has no income and that gasoline prices are expected to increase. The video reflects economic concerns.

Mojtaba Delavar, a political prisoner, is serving his 28-year sentence in Evin Prison. He was sentenced by Branch 15 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court on various charges including propaganda against the regime and support for the Zionist regime. His total sentence is 28 years in prison.

Al-Hadath reported, citing its sources, that the Iraqi government is concerned about US pressure to enforce sanctions imposed on the Islamic Republic. This pressure includes imposing restrictions on land border crossings with Iran and preventing Iranian planes from landing at Iraqi airports. The US government has announced the start of a major economic operation against the Islamic Republic starting Monday, August 24, 2026.

Emmanuel Macron, the President of France, will meet with Mohammed bin Salman, the Crown Prince of Saudi Arabia, in Paris today. The meeting will focus on expanding bilateral cooperation and discussing developments in the Middle East. They will talk about regional issues, including the actions of the Islamic Republic.

Today, Monday, 2 Shahrivar, the execution of a prisoner was carried out in Adelabad Prison in Shiraz. The prisoner was named Bahram Keshavarzi from Beyza County. His execution was related to non-political charges.

A citizen sent a video to Iran International on August 24 showing contaminated drinking water in Azimieh, Karaj. The video depicts the water condition in this area. The issue of water contamination in Azimieh, Karaj has attracted attention.

A report from the Austrian Economic Research Institute indicates that the war related to the Islamic Republic and rising oil prices have halted Austria's economic recovery. The retail sector in Austria was effectively in recession during the first half of the year. This report was published by Ali Hassanpour from Iran International.

Tractor football team defeated Persepolis 1-0 in the third week of the Premier League. The only goal was scored by Tomislav Sturkalic in the 90th minute. The match was held without spectators at Sahand Stadium in Tabriz.

Benjamin Netanyahu claimed that the Islamic Republic of Iran tried to find and assassinate one of his sons. He described this action as unacceptable and emphasized the necessity of protecting his children. Netanyahu did not provide further details about the information he had.

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, announced that under Donald Trump's order, an economic expulsion operation against the Islamic Republic and its supporters has begun. The goal is to cut off all economic lifelines of the Iranian government to isolate Tehran. Bessent also mentioned two paths ahead for the Iranian government: complete isolation or a return to normal conditions.

Scott Bessant, the US Treasury Secretary, stated that no country can claim ignorance about supporting Iran. He said countries that empower Iran or facilitate its financial income are accomplices to the Iranian government. He also emphasized that countries standing with the US will benefit from support, while others will be isolated.

Scott Bassett, the US Treasury Secretary, announced that the final stage of the largest financial attack against Tehran begins today. Donald Trump also stated that the Islamic Republic is collapsing. The value of Iran's national currency has reached its lowest historical level.

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, stated that the Berlin Wall fell when ordinary soldiers refused to shoot their own citizens. He warned those in Tehran not to test Washington's will and emphasized that no country tolerates others seeking its destruction. Bessent added that the Iranian regime must choose between isolation and prosperity, or peace and war, and the world must decide whether to be with or without the US.

Contract workers of Ilam Municipality's green space have not received their salaries for three months. Employees of Aseman Airlines in Shiraz face delayed salary payments, insurance cuts, and job uncertainty. They are demanding attention to their situation.

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, announced new sanctions targeting five vital areas used by Iran in other countries: digital assets, technology, gold, aviation, and shipping. He warned that any entity facilitating money laundering on behalf of Iran will be removed from the US dollar system. Additionally, the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control will sanction over 60 entities, individuals, and ships worldwide.

Mohsen Rezaei met with Asim Munir and expressed distrust towards the US, stating that the US must change its behavior. He emphasized the implementation of the memorandum's conditions. The meeting also highlighted the Islamic Republic's security management over the Strait of Hormuz.

Ali Dadpay said the US is trying to eliminate ways to bypass sanctions and trade with the Islamic Republic. He added that channels for transferring money and goods to Iran have become limited and complex. After identifying money laundering centers, the US knows where to target.

A citizen sarcastically responded to officials' claims about progress in the Islamic Republic in a video. He placed a one-dollar bill against dozens of thousand and two-thousand toman bills. Above the bills, it was written: "Peaks of progress, sanctions have no effect."

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, in a meeting to announce the start of the economic exclusion operation against the Islamic Republic, told the regime's ordinary soldiers to remember that the Berlin Wall fell when ordinary soldiers decided not to shoot their own people. He also said that as more of your paychecks are cut or delayed, ask yourselves whether your commanders are leading the country to victory or destruction.

Nejat Bahrami said the new US economic campaign resembles a military campaign and its success depends on the continuation of policies. He added that if pressures continue and regional countries close the routes to bypass sanctions, the Islamic Republic will face an unprecedented crisis. There is also a possibility of a preventive military action by the Islamic Republic.

Mehdi Tartaar, Persepolis coach, apologized to fans after the loss against Reactor and took responsibility for the defeat. He mentioned that playing young players has its consequences, with most substitutes aged 20 to 22. He also cited the absence of spectators in the stadium as the reason for the dull game.

On the early morning of Sunday, 1 Shahrivar, the execution of a prisoner named Navid Mohammadpour was carried out in Dehdasht prison. The prisoner had previously been sentenced to death for murder. The news was reported by HRANA news agency.

The Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) of the United States sanctioned 24 individuals, 48 entities and companies, and six ships for ties to the Islamic Republic. Amir Hatami, Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr, and Reza Talaei-Nik are among those sanctioned. Two Iranian companies and 18 companies from China and Hong Kong, eight from the United Arab Emirates, five from India, and four from Turkey were also sanctioned.

The US Central Command announced that until August 24, it has changed the course of 71 commercial ships and disabled three ships. US forces have boarded two ships. More than 40 humanitarian aid ships were allowed to pass.
Masoud Pezeshkian met with Asim Munir and stated that the US should change its tone and approach in dealing with Iran. He emphasized that bullying and coercion only complicate executive processes.

Sirus Hamidi and Maryam Moradian were arrested by security forces in Divandareh on August 14 and transferred to Sanandaj prison. Their 16-year-old daughter, Kordia Hamidi, was also arrested with them and released after four days.

At the end of the third week of the Iranian Premier League, Esteghlal topped the table with 9 points and a better goal difference than Tractor. Gol Gohar Sirjan and Aluminium Arak are in third and fourth places respectively. Persepolis dropped to fifth after losing to Tractor, and Foolad reached the upper half of the table.

In recent weeks in Iran, there has been a wave of Instagram page blocks, content removals, summons of virtual space activists, and closure of business units. At least 72 pages have been blocked and 23 business units have been closed. These actions are not limited to political activists but also include bloggers, online businesses, and cultural groups.

The office of the Israeli Prime Minister congratulated Donald Trump and Scott Bassent on new sanctions against the Iranian government. Netanyahu described these sanctions as a correct measure against Iran's dictatorship and its supporters of aggression.

Alireza Namvar Haghighi stated that the Trump administration's policy has shifted to the Treasury Department, and the Treasury Secretary's plan is a comprehensive economic pressure against Iran. These sanctions target various sectors of Iran's economy and its land and air routes. He suggested that the Islamic Republic may have to return to a path of understanding and viewed Asim Munir's trip to Tehran in this context.

Ali Madanizadeh, the Minister of Economy, stated that they are fully prepared against the new US sanctions. He said that they cannot cut the country's financial lifelines. The fourteenth government has planned in advance to counter the sanctions.

The Commander of the Islamic Republic's Law Enforcement warned that gasoline, the economy, and unemployment could be reasons for protests in the country. He emphasized that cyber police and public security police must identify hidden layers in society and social networks and deal with those who incite people. These remarks were made in an interview with Ali Shirazi.

Miad Maleki stated that the new US sanctions target not only government institutions but the entire Iranian economy in sectors such as shipping, gold, digital currencies, and financial networks. The US is also applying diplomatic pressure to block ways to circumvent sanctions. China has reduced its trade with Iran due to its dependence on the US financial system.

Flooding caused by Typhoon Nara affected parts of Guangxi in southern China. The Ningming county government called for immediate evacuation of low-lying areas, and about 54,000 people have been relocated. Heavy rain will continue until Wednesday.

Russia announced that it is ready to support mediation efforts to end the war against Iran and maintain stability in the Middle East if requested. This support may include Moscow's updated plan for Gulf security. Experts believe third-party mediation is necessary, but lack of trust hinders progress.

Marco Rubio, US Secretary of State, announced on X that the US has officially removed Syria from the list of state sponsors of terrorism. He wrote that this action paves the way for new capacities for economic revival and progress of Syria. Rubio emphasized that the Trump administration continues to advance US national security goals for peace, prosperity, and security in the Middle East.

Saudi Arabia and France issued a joint statement emphasizing a diplomatic solution for Iran's nuclear program and called for Tehran's full cooperation with the IAEA. They condemned attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz and demanded a return to pre-March 2026 shipping conditions. They also stressed that ship passage should be free of charges and restrictions.

Morad Veysi said Scott Busent sent a message to the Islamic Republic's suppression forces to distance themselves from the regime and not shoot at the people. He added that the Iranian people will eventually overthrow the Islamic Republic. Increased economic and military pressure from the US can weaken the regime.

The price of the dollar has risen to 202,500 tomans on some rate announcement websites. Reports indicate that the dollar has increased by nearly 15,000 tomans in one week. This price increase has been reported by domestic media.

Reza Pahlavi congratulated the people of Ukraine on the 35th anniversary of their independence by sharing a photo of his meeting with Volodymyr Zelensky. He emphasized that the Iranian people stand shoulder to shoulder with Ukrainians in their fight against aggression and occupation. He also appreciated the solidarity of the Ukrainian people with Iranians in their struggle for freedom.

Mohammad Reza Aref criticized the plan to counter foreign infiltration in the country and said the Speaker of the Parliament promised to remove the plan from the agenda. He emphasized the need to resolve the issue through negotiations with institutions like the Expediency Discernment Council. Aref warned that passing this plan would deal a more severe blow to the science and technology sector than the 2023 law.
A tanker about 9 nautical miles northeast of the Shisah area in Oman was hit by an unknown projectile and disabled. The attack damaged the ship's engine room. The crew is reported to be safe.

Morad Veysi reported a serious shortage of gasoline and closure of fuel stations in Shiraz and Tehran. He described this as a sign of a nationwide gasoline supply crisis. He warned that the situation could worsen if current policies continue.

Katayoun Riahi announced that her case has been referred to the investigative judge of the Culture and Media Prosecutor's Office. The charges of the new case are not yet clear. She had previously faced charges such as assembly and collusion against national security.

Iranian media published a poem attributed to Ali Khamenei as a sign of his predicted death. Social media users found a hidden message by combining the first letters of the verses: "I, Ali Khamenei, am born of the devil." Kambiz Hosseini discussed this topic in a program.

Mohsen Rezaei officially introduced the logic of nuclear deterrence for the first time as Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council. He stated that if Iran is attacked without nuclear weapons, why not build them? These remarks were made amid sanctions and economic hardships.

Asaad Hassan Al-Shibani, Syria's foreign minister, welcomed the removal of Syria's name from the list of state sponsors of terrorism as a historic event. He said this step is the result of changes made by Syrians and reflects the new government's commitment to peace and international security. He also emphasized that the government will continue efforts to overcome isolation and create an environment based on transparency.

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, announced the launch of a campaign of economic isolation against the Islamic Republic, stating that five sectors—gold, cryptocurrency, shipping, aviation, and technology—are subject to secondary sanctions. Simultaneously, new sanctions have been imposed on 60 individuals, entities, and ships, as well as hackers linked to the Ministry of Intelligence. Washington expects other countries to join the UAE in cutting trade ties with Iran.

The Eiffel Tower in Paris was lit up in the blue and yellow colors of the Ukrainian flag. This was done to commemorate the 35th anniversary of Ukraine's independence. The deputy mayor of Paris described the celebration as a symbol of friendship between France and Ukraine.

The US State Department spokesperson announced sanctions on individuals, entities, and vessels for facilitating Iran's destabilizing activities. These activities include attacks on US forces, illegal weapons procurement, cyber intrusions into US infrastructure, and energy shipments to fund terrorism. The sanctions target military officials, a cyber group, and a network of shipping companies in the UAE, China, Singapore, and Europe.

Senator Marsha Blackburn told Newsmax that Iran is facing unprecedented inflation and that the army and police are unable to pay their employees. She also referred to Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's mention of more actions to come, and said the Treasury has identified and sanctioned various entities and individuals. Blackburn stressed the need for regional allies to join in ensuring Iran's financial isolation.

Antonio Guterres, the UN Secretary-General, proposed facilitating the passage of fertilizer shipments through the Strait of Hormuz. The aim is to reduce risks and help ensure more regular transit. This mechanism will be implemented only with the agreement of all countries involved in the conflict.

The New Yorker reported that the Islamic Republic uses mafia members, criminal gangs, and European teenagers to target opponents and journalists abroad. Matthew Levitt has documented over 200 assassination plots supported by the Islamic Republic in the past five years. Threats against Iran International staff and their families have increased.

The Washington Post editorial board has supported the start of an economic ostracism operation against the Islamic Republic. The newspaper emphasized that effective implementation of this policy requires confronting China. The goal of this policy is to weaken and contain the Islamic Republic, not to change the government.

Insurance companies consider ships related to Saudi Arabia as higher risk assets due to the Iran war and Houthi attacks, increasing insurance costs. Saudi Arabia is negotiating with insurance brokers in London about a war and political risk insurance plan. This plan could cover up to 700 million Saudi riyals per incident.

Kayhan newspaper stated that inflation and the rise in the dollar price are due to wrong currency policies and the removal of preferential currency, not the war or closing the Strait of Hormuz. The newspaper called the claim that the war caused inflation a big lie. It also described closing the Strait of Hormuz as a strategy to pressure the US.

Fadahossein Maleki stated that the consequences of economic war are more serious than military attacks. He said the effects of the economic war will be longer-lasting. He also emphasized that the Islamic Republic should use legal and international opportunities to assert its rights.

Donald Trump announced that from January 1, tariffs on imports of cars, trucks, auto parts, and steel from Canada will increase to 50 percent. He called Canada one of the worst countries to do business with. Trump warned that if Canada obstructs, the consequences for Ottawa will be worse.

Shahram Khaledi highlighted that the main difference in the new US sanctions campaign is the active naval blockade and the denial of dollar transactions. He mentioned the expansion of secondary sanctions to chains related to transactions with the Islamic Republic. The use of cryptocurrencies as a sanction tool was also noted.

Houshang Hasan-Yari pointed to increasing economic, military, and political pressures by the US against the Islamic Republic. He said we are gradually entering a phase where war will be inevitable. He predicted that the final battle between the US and the Islamic Republic will happen soon.

Asia-Pacific media have focused on the US economic boycott campaign, highlighting increased pressure on Iran and its trade partners. Australian and New Zealand media emphasized the fall of the rial, inflation, and medicine shortages. Asian media reported on hidden financial networks, oil smuggling, and sanctions on Chinese and Hong Kong companies.

Omid Memarian, a political analyst, reported an increase in assassinations attributed to the Islamic Republic outside Iran. He stated that the authorities use new methods such as creating fear and threats to suppress opponents. These methods also include planning murders.

Erfan Ghaneifard stated that the US and its intelligence community aim to disrupt operational activities within the IRGC. These actions are intended both to gather information and to create divisions in the IRGC's command structure. These remarks were made amid increased economic pressure from the US.

The US Secretary of Defense stated that the new economic campaign against Iran does not mean the elimination of the military option. He emphasized that "we are by no means ruling out the option of using military attacks in the Strait of Hormuz or around Iran." The US Secretary of Defense also expressed the opinion that Iran cannot withstand the new economic pressure.

The Pakistani army commander discussed with Iranian officials measures to prevent escalation and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Pakistani interior minister had a positive meeting with the President of the Islamic Republic. This report was published by Javad Hamdani from Iran International.

Mehdi Chamran, head of Tehran City Council, said if the enemy intends to attack again, Iran will preemptively strike. He also mentioned strong resistance in the recent war and pushing the enemy back. These remarks were made during a Tehran City Council session.
Videos received show that despite the fuel station in Gohardasht Karaj being closed with its lights off, cars are lined up to receive gasoline there.

Morteza Kazemian said that US sanctions increase pressure on the Islamic Republic but do not necessarily lead to regime change. The Islamic Republic has learned mechanisms to bypass sanctions and passes economic pressure onto the people. He emphasized that the Iranian people are the main actors in this situation and are absent in the Trump administration's discussions about the sanctions.

Alireza Beiranvand's playing card for Tractor is valid until September 21. If a new letter or inquiry is received, the validity will be extended until the Asian Cup and mid-season. Beiranvand is not included in the preliminary list of the U23 team for the Nagoya Asian Games.

Hamzeh Darvish, a Sunni prisoner in Lakaan Prison in Rasht, was transferred from solitary confinement back to the general ward. This transfer took place on Tuesday, 2 Shahrivar. Previously, he had been held in solitary confinement as a form of punishment.
